messages:
sasha: ticking over to @liam for the midnight window. quick summary below, nothing critical but a few things to watch.

sasha: WHAT CHANGED —
- canary deploy of routing-v2 finished at 23:40 UTC (no rollback).
- small db migration (metrics.schema.v3) ran in read-only mode; reverted due to a flaky index build, all reads normal now.
- rate-limiter tweak deployed to prod: low-weight endpoints now have slightly stricter burst limits (might see transient 429s).

sasha: WATCHLIST/WHY IT MATTERS —
- endpoints /v1/stream and /v1/complete may return 429s for very short bursts. if >5% 429s sustained for 5m, flip rl policy to old-profile (see runbook).
- metrics ingestion lag may spike while index rebuild finishes; dashboards will look delayed.

sasha: ACTIONS FOR TONIGHT —
- @liam: keep an eye on 429 rate for stream (alert: infra/rl-429-stream). escalate to eng-runtime if sustained.
- @anita: verify KV cache evictions after the migration (prefetch logs under /var/logs/prefetch).
- @chris: hold the redeploy for routing-v2-canary until 03:00 UTC if any regressions observed.

liam: noted. I'll watch the 429 alarm and post if it trips. quick Q — where's the knob to flip rl profile?

sasha: runbook snippet: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/reload-policy -d '{"policy":"old-profile"}'` or use console -> Routing -> Rate limits -> revert. I left the API token under the team vault entry.

anita: checking KV stats now. quick grep I ran: `jq '.evictions' /var/logs/prefetch/kv-summary.json` shows evictions up 1.2% in last 15m, within expected. will re-check in 30m.

chris: i'm on pager for the next 2h, can take redeploy hold. i'll also watch canary logs for slowdowns (looking at p95).

oncall-bot: Reminder: night-rotation swap at 00:30 UTC. @liam is primary until 08:00 UTC.

liam: thanks. small ping — two PRs need reviews that touch the streaming path, i'll try to do quick LGTM for the safe one.

anita: FYI — I left a short snippet in the infra runbook about the index rollback steps in case we need to replay: `/docs/runbook/index-rollback.md`.

sasha: one last note: user-facing rate-limited errors should show the new friendly message; if we get complaints route them to support with tag `#rl-jan` so we can correlate.

liam: ack. i'll post an hourly check-in at :00 and :30. otherwise will escalate to eng-runtime on any sustained regressions. :thumbsup:

chris: thanks all — taking over watch for the redeploy hold. ping me in thread if anything pops.
